From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@spintechevents.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question about sponsor lead numbers from Redwood Summit

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for hosting us at the Redwood Summit booth last week — we appreciated the traffic. Quick heads-up: the sponsorship report we received from your events dashboard lists 42 sponsor-qualified leads tied to SpinTech (column: sponsor_qualified), but our HubSpot export only shows 27 unique contacts tied to the SpinTech sponsor touch. The difference is material for our post-event ROI and payout schedule.

I've attached our raw export (SpinTech_leads_Q2.csv) and flagged a few sample Lead IDs in the first tab that we believe should map to the report. Can you please:
- Confirm the definition you used for "sponsor-qualified" leads in the dashboard
- Share the raw data extract (CSV) used to compute the 42 number
- Let us know if you dedup by email or by form-submission id

This is time-sensitive as we finalize our sponsor invoice next week.

Best,
Maya Patel
Director, Sponsorships
SpinTech Events

Attachment: SpinTech_leads_Q2.csv (CSV, 38KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question about sponsor lead numbers from Redwood Summit

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the export.

Short answer: our dashboard counts "sponsor-qualified" as unique leads that: (a) visited the sponsor booth and scanned the QR OR submitted the sponsor form AND (b) met the MQL criteria in our scoring sheet. That said, we may be double-counting in cases where the same person scanned + submitted via email (we try to dedupe by email, but older form submissions sometimes create duplicates if there was a redirect).

Looping in Ben (events analytics) and Neha (account lead) to pull the raw dashboard extract and run a focused dedupe. We'll produce:
- Raw extract used to compute the 42 figure
- A reconciled list with 'source' and a reconciliation flag
- Suggested final number and notes on any assumptions

I can have an initial recon by tomorrow EOD and a final by Friday. Does that timeline work on your end?

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Field Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference

> Hi Maya — thanks for the note and the export.

I've pulled the dashboard extract and attached our internal HubSpot pull (hs-export-SpinTech-20260714.csv). Initial read:

Findings (quick):
- Dashboard counted 42 unique "sponsor_qualified" rows across two sources: booth-scan events (QR) and sponsor-form submissions.
- HS export shows 27 unique contacts with the sponsor UTM tag.
- ~9 records look like duplicates where the same email appears with both a scan event and a form submission created as separate contact records (legacy form flow created duplicate contacts).
- ~6 records appear to be partner-registered leads (registered by a channel partner, not end-user form) — we tag those differently but they were included in the dashboard run.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Run dedupe by canonical email and merge duplicates (I can run our dedupe script)
2) Exclude partner-registered records unless SpinTech wants those counted as sponsor-sourced
3) Produce a heatmap showing source breakdown (QR vs form vs partner) — will post to Drive.

Attaching: hs-export-SpinTech-20260714.csv (attachment)

I'll run the dedupe now and send the reconciled CSV back within ~3 hours.

- Ben

Thanks Ben — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side:
- SpinTech counts any lead handed to a sponsor rep at the booth (including partner-registered introductions) as sponsor-sourced unless explicitly gatewayed to a partner.
- Our internal agreement (section 3.1) lists "unique contact" by email as the canonical method but we have historically accepted partner-introduced leads on a case-by-case basis.

I'm attaching the signed contract for reference (spintech_sponsor_contract.pdf). If partner-introduced leads are being excluded by your standard dashboard run, that's probably the bulk of the delta.

We'd like a reconciled list showing: contact email, hubspot id, source (QR/form/partner), and final sponsor_count flag. Also please flag any leads you dedupe by merging multiple contact records and indicate the rule used.

—Maya

Attachment: spintech_sponsor_contract.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
